channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Vang: It’s clear who the villains of this story are
item.description: What does it mean for Minnesotans when federal violence enters the geography of our state?

item.title: Takeaways: Mats Zuccarello’s overtime goal lifts Wild to 3-2 victory at Seattle
item.description: The Wild ended their seven-game road trip with a fourth victory that was secured only after they blew a two-goal lead in the third period.

item.title: State freezes enrollment of new providers in Medicaid programs at risk for fraud
item.description: The state Department of Human Services’ moratorium will last at least six months. It comes as Minnesota is under national scrutiny for fraud in social services programs.

item.title: Takeaways: Anthony Edwards reaches 10,000 points as Timberwolves top Cavaliers 131-122 for fourth consecutive victory
item.description: The Wolves took command with a spectacular third quarter before Anthony Edwards became the third-youngest player in NBA history to reach 10,000 points.

item.title: Watch out for AI fakes and misinformation in the wake of ICE shooting
item.description: A wave of AI-adjusted images and videos purporting to show the agent’s face has made the rounds on social media.

item.title: We talked to 5 use-of-force experts. This is what they say about the Minneapolis ICE shooting.
item.description: Legal experts are stunned the Trump administration has prejudged the agent’s actions and blocked a state investigation.

item.title: What happened in other ICE shootings during Trump’s immigration enforcement?
item.description: Nearly every case had common factors with the Minneapolis shooting: officers shot or fired at, people in a vehicle.

item.title: Walz tells ICE to ‘stay away’ from Minnesota schools after series of incidents near campuses
item.description: Minneapolis schools canceled classes after two schools went into lockdowns in south Minneapolis, within miles of an ICE shooting.

item.title: U.S. citizen swept up in ICE enforcement as Twin Cities operation continues
item.description: The arrest in a Robbinsdale parking lot was streamed live on Facebook and comes a day after the fatal shooting of a U.S. citizen by an ICE agent.

item.title: Tensions running high in Minnesota as ICE operation, protests continue
item.description: A day after an ICE agent killed a woman in south Minneapolis, federal and state officials are clashing over what happened as the FBI takes control of the investigation.
